title: Register a business name
summary: Learn about registering a business name (or trading name) if you operate your business under a name different from your own.
intro:
You need to register a business name if you conduct business under a name other than your own. A business name, also known as a trading name, is a name or title under which a person, or other legal entity, carries on business.

When you register a business name, you register it nationally. This means you can operate your business in any state or territory in Australia.

Registering a business name will prevent others from registering the exact business name, but not from trading with a similar business name or likeness. For that, you'll need to register a trademark.
